title: Registry of Patients Having Received oNKord®
official: A Prospective Multicenter Observational Study to Assess Long-term Outcome of Participants Who Have Received oNKord®
summary: ReKORD is an observational study (Registry) enrolling participants who have received at least one dose of oNKord® (allogeneic ex vivo-generated Natural Killer \[NK\] cells from CD34+ umbilical cord blood progenitor cells) in a clinical trial. Participants from multiple previous clinical trials of oNKord® can be enrolled in this Registry.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Receipt of at least one dose of oNKord® in a clinical trial
* Participation must be within 3 years after the first infusion of oNKord®
* Signature of ICF

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
